articles.title: Pakistan hikes petrol, diesel prices by over PKR 13 per litre amid West Asia crisis
articles.titleEn: Pakistan hikes petrol, diesel prices by over PKR 13 per litre amid West Asia crisis
articles.summary: The price of petrol has been raised by PKR 13.18 per litre to PKR 310.71 per litre, while high-speed diesel will now cost PKR 323.30 per litre after an increase of PKR 13.80 per litre. The revised prices came into effect on July 12, the Dawn reported.

articles.body:
